AfterDeath.rationale: One of monster_state_machine boundary-hole 5's eleven unclaimed C# hook overrides, handed to this stream. Read to the end (the KinPriest/N6 lesson): SoulFysh.cs:81-89 is `if (creature != Creature) return;` followed by `NRunMusicController.Instance?.UpdateMusicParameter("soulfysh_progress", 5f)` and nothing else. The ENTIRE override is a music parameter -- no state change, no command, no hook dispatch -- so there is no mechanical behaviour for the sim to be missing. Waiver, presentation, exactly as N6 waived KinPriest. hook_dispatch's G5 (no MonsterModel listener category) is NOT re-verdicted here.

AfterCardChangedPilesLate.rationale: The second of this unit's two boundary-hole-5 overrides. SoulFysh.cs:91-108: three early returns (not my player's card / not a Beckon / combat is over), then a Hand scan `Hand.Cards.Any(c is Beckon)` whose ONLY consumer is `NRunMusicController...UpdateMusicParameter("beckon", flag ? 1 : 0)`. The scan result is never stored and never read again, so the whole override is a music parameter. Read to the end before verdicting, per N6.

Even the registration list order matches C#'s ([beckon, de_gas, gaze, scream, fade]). Executed (monster_probes_b04.py graphs).

guards.what: BECKON / GAZE card placement and pile
guards.rationale: SoulFysh.cs:141-147 creates TWO Beckons: the first via AddGeneratedCardToCombat(card, PileType.Draw, null, CardPilePosition.Random) and the second into PileType.Discard, in that order; GAZE (:165-168) adds ONE into Discard after the attack. Sim _beckon (soul_fysh.py:61-65) calls CardPileCmd.add_to_draw then add_to_discard, and add_to_draw (cmds.py:475-497) is documented and implemented as the Random position drawn from the SHUFFLE stream; _gaze (:70-74) attacks then adds one to the discard. Executed (monster_probes_b04.py fysh-beckon): BECKON draw 4->5 with the new card at index 1 of 5 (not top, not bottom) and discard 0->1; GAZE discard 1->2 after the hit lands.

guards.rationale: Presentation only (SHARED-FINDINGS section 4; monster_state_machine N2/N5). The sim models no audio, animation, spine skins, asset preloading or Bestiary, so there is nothing mechanical to port. SoulFysh.cs:68-79 / :187 / :199. Every read of IsInvisible is a GenerateAnimator AddAnyState predicate (SoulFysh.cs:237-240) choosing between the normal and intangible hurt/death animations. It gates nothing mechanical -- the actual damage reduction is IntangiblePower, which the sim applies.

SoulFysh.cs:189-193 awaits the attack and then PowerCmd.Apply<VulnerablePower>(targets, 3), so the Vulnerable does not amplify the hit that applied it; sim _scream (soul_fysh.py:81-85) has the same order.
